page.overview:
What is Todorokutsuki?

Roaring Moon is a Pokémon that resembles Mega Salamence. It is a large dragon with short stubby legs and a long tail. It's arms are long, ending in three massive claws. It's head is armored and it's wings are large and curl up into a moon shape not too dissimilar from Lunala though there is absolutely no relation. It's main body is primarily blue, with its wings taking on a red color with blue and black accents. It also has some yellow detailing on it's belly and on the area around it's torso on the wings.

It is believed to have a much more savage nature than even Salamence. As a result, humans must avoid contact should one encounter Roaring Moon.

Roaring Moon can only have the ability Protosynthesis, which will boost its most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if it's holding a Booster Energy.

Similar to Iron Valiant, Roaring Moon is based on Mega Evolution (more specifically, Mega Salamence). Its overall body design may also draw inspiration from of European mythology. Its feathers are similar to feathered dinosaurs while its wing shape is similar to a crescent moon, commonly used as an icon in Islamic societies, and considering that Paldea was inspired by Spain, it maybe a reference to , a Muslim-ruled area of the Iberian Peninsula during the Middle Ages.
